top.description: Player 1 background (Marty + Doc). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed 1980s movie still of a single unified scene at the Twin Pines Mall parking lot at night, 1:1 square aspect ratio. On the far left, Marty McFly is standing in his iconic red puffy vest and denim jacket, holding a pink hoverboard under his arm, looking back in awe. On the far right, Doc Emmett Brown is standing with wild white hair and his white radiation suit, holding a glowing remote control with digital dials. The legendary DeLorean time machine is parked in the distant background, emitting a soft blue electrical aura. The entire middle-center area of the dark asphalt parking lot is completely clean, empty, and free of objects, with dry ice fog drifting across. Dramatic high-contrast theatrical lighting, neon blue and orange highlight reflections, film grain, photorealistic cinematic style. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Biff + matones). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A cinematic, highly detailed 1950s movie still of a single unified scene in a dark wet alley behind a diner, 1:1 square aspect ratio. On the far left, Biff Tannen stands confidently in his green and white high school letterman jacket, holding a wooden baseball bat, leaning against the glossy black fender of his classic 1946 Ford convertible. On the far right, his three henchmen (one wearing vintage 3D glasses) stand in the shadows, looking tough. The center of the alley is completely empty and clean, showing only dark, wet asphalt pavement with beautiful reflections of a flickering neon sign. Dramatic film noir lighting, warm amber and cool cyan hues, realistic movie atmosphere, film grain. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Marty vs Biff jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous cinematic 1950s movie still of Marty McFly and Biff Tannen sitting face-to-face in a red vinyl diner booth, playing a match of Magic: The Gathering, vertical 9:16 portrait. Marty McFly, looking nervous and sweating, holds a hand of cards showing the iconic brown Magic: The Gathering card back with the oval logo and five colored circles. Biff Tannen, with a smug, aggressive sneer, is slamming a card down on the chrome-rimmed table. On the table, a correct Magic: The Gathering card battlefield is laid out: rows of black-bordered fantasy cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees showing they are 'tapped' (used), next to a chocolate milkshake with a red straw. Through the large glass window of the diner, the silver DeLorean time machine is parked under a neon streetlamp, casting a soft blue glow. Warm retro neon lighting, cinematic film grain, detailed faces. --ar 9:16 --no poker cards, standard playing cards, hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons
